crossRefs.note: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,
Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.
For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.
Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.
All Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king; for they saw that the wisdom of…

translations.web: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;
translations.bsb: and for receiving instruction in wise living and in righteousness, justice, and equity.
translations.kjv: To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity;
translations.asv: To receive instruction in wise dealing, In righteousness and justice and equity;
